technical.rationale: novelty以手配同一lua-language-server和共享LSP为参照，没有新语言分析或协议算法0（Q01）。mechanism以直接配置为参照，默认命令/扩展合并及UnavailableProvider构成有限装配机制8；协议和延迟启动归共享基座，宽catch有边界（Q01/Q02）。transferability以单机硬编码为参照，命令/参数/env/配置可覆盖便于不同LuaLS安装复用10，仍依赖DSH共享接口（Q01/Q03）。simplification以每个profile手填Lua命令和映射为参照，默认值减少接线8，服务器安装和失败归因仍需人工（Q02/Q04）。

business.rationale: workflow以人工给共享基座增加LuaLS命令与.lua表为参照，现成provider减少配置交接18，实际导航语义仍由服务器决定（Q01/Q03）。delivery以同一LuaLS提供的定义/引用/实现/hover为参照，业务结果与验收单位未改变，安装包不是新交付0（Q01）。reach以需自行理解stdio配置的DSH使用者为参照，默认命令和映射降低接入门槛5，不以Lua用户范围本身当增量（Q01）。economics以手配同一共享基座/LuaLS为参照，本包未新增缓存、批处理或索引资源组织0；延迟启动与进程预算归共享基座，不重复计作本包经济创新，净人工/资源收益未知（Q01/Q04）。

# dsh-lsp-lua > 以 lua-language-server 为外部服务器的 Lua LSP 配置包，默认 --stdio 与 .lua→lua。 ## 研究范围 - **仓库**：[988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs) - **版本号**：0.1.0（[固定提交 258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/tree/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce)） - **版本日期**：2026-09-01（固定提交日期，北京时间；不是包发布日期） ## 结论状态 源码支持命令/路由及降级；真实 LuaLS 运行未验证。 ## 洞察短评 - **用途**：在 DSH 中查询 Lua 文件定义、引用、实现、hover。 - **亮点**：减少 Lua LSP 装配；不实现协议，详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 - **思考**：宽 catch 可能误判故障，fallback 不保留自定义扩展；详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 - **建议**：保留合并扩展并区分配置、服务器和注册错误，反证条件与代价见[Q05](#research-q05)。 采用建议：先核 lua-language-server --stdio 和共享基座，再以真实 Lua 模块试四操作；详见[Q03](#research-q03)。 ## 核心贡献 减少 Lua LSP 装配；不实现协议，详见[Q01](#research-q01)。 ## 关键质疑 宽 catch 可能误判故障，fallback 不保留自定义扩展；详见[Q02](#research-q02)。 ## 重点创新推演与最小验证 保留合并扩展并区分配置、服务器和注册错误，反证条件与代价见[Q05](#research-q05)。 隔离测缺服/配置失败/自定义扩展，真实 Lua 模块和 implementation。 ## 场景与替代办法 在 DSH 中查询 Lua 文件定义、引用、实现、hover。 手工在共享 LSP 配置增加 lua-language-server 与 .lua 映射。 ## 依赖与流程 DSH LSP service/tool、fs/subprocess 与 LuaLS。 安装 LuaLS→挂共享基座→安装包→测 Lua 文件/模块导航。 ## 成本与效果 #### 成本 | 阶段 | 现金与资源成本 | 人工与时间投入 | 已知条件与未知项 | | --- | --- | --- | --- | | 首次使用 | 外部LuaLS与共享LSP基座安装磁盘/下载，价格未知 | 配PATH/命令/工作区及扩展表，核版本，工时未知 | 包不附服务器，单文件lane不是项目兼容证明 | | 持续使用 | 基座按需启动LuaLS，项目索引/文档与协议进程资源，实际耗量未知 | 核导航语义及扩展路由，工时未知 | 默认预算由共享stdio实现填充，不把此包当新索引算法 | | 失败恢复 | 重装/重启服务器与重新索引资源，金额未知 | 区分配置/命令/注册失败，恢复自定义扩展，工时未知 | 宽catch可能误报缺服；fallback只保默认.lua，真实恢复率未知 | 减少手工维护 LuaLS 命令与路由；实际导航待测。 ## 研究问题与完整回答 **插件研究总目标：**核实 LuaLS 配置包的 --stdio、单文件前提和故障降级。 ### Q01 · Lua 导航功能由配置包还是 lua-language-server/共享基座提供？ **研究主题：**场景与需求、贡献与相对优势、功能与机制 #### 完整回答 该薄包注册 lua provider，.lua→lua，以 lua-language-server --stdio 启动外部服务器；LSP 协议和模型工具来自共享基座。包不安装 LuaLS，README 给出 brew/scoop/release 安装方式。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-lua/README.md:3-27](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/README.md#L3-L27) 声明薄配置包、lua-language-server 外部安装。
查看原文（25行） ````text > Lua language configuration pack for DeepSeek Harness (DSH). lua-language-server — LuaLS, the reference Lua language server. > 中文：DSH 的 Lua LSP「即插即用」语言包 —— 装上本包，.lua 文件即可用 `lsp` 工具做代码导航。 This pack is one Cordis configuration plugin: it registers a configured `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` instance on `ctx.lsp` with the server command, launch arguments, and extension mapping for Lua. It implements **no LSP protocol** — the shared base does: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp` (the seam) + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-lsp` (the model-facing `lsp` tool with `goToDefinition` / `findReferences` / `goToImplementation` / `hover`). Twelve packs reuse one unchanged base. ## Installing the language server ```bash # Homebrew: brew install lua-language-server # scoop: scoop install lua-language-server # or download a release binary from github.com/LuaLS/lua-language-server ``` `lua-language-server` must be on `PATH`; stdio mode is requested with `--stdio`, which this pack passes by default. > ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the > upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts:28-46](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts#L28-L46) provider、注入依赖、默认命令与单扩展表。
查看原文（19行） ```text /** Cordis plugin name for loader diagnostics. */ export const name = 'lsp-lua' /** Services required by the shared LSP base this pack assembles. */ export const inject = ['fs', 'lsp', 'subprocess'] /** Stable provider id reserved on `ctx.lsp` by this pack. */ export const PROVIDER_ID = 'lua' /** Default server command (absolute path or PATH-resolved executable, no shell). */ export const DEFAULT_COMMAND = 'lua-language-server' /** Default launch arguments. */ export const DEFAULT_ARGS: readonly string[] = ["--stdio"] /** Default lowercase leading-dot extension → LSP language id table. */ export const DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE: Readonly> = { ".lua": "lua" } ```
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts:152-160](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts#L152-L160) 委托 LspStdio。 ```text export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return ``` #### 缺口 - 未启动 LuaLS **影响：**真实 Lua 模块导航/诊断未知 **进一步探讨：**在真实 Lua 项目试四项导航 ### Q02 · 缺服降级是否保留自定义扩展并准确区分故障？ **研究主题：**工程质量与复用、缺陷与关键质疑 #### 完整回答 正常配置会合并自定义扩展；LspStdio.Config/apply 被一个 catch 包住，错误一律描述为 lua-language-server 不可用，并用 DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE 注册 fallback。因此配置/注册问题可被误归因，自定义扩展在降级时消失。resolveServerConfig 在 try 外，仍可向外抛。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts:103-118](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts#L103-L118) 默认与用户覆盖合并。
查看原文（16行） ```text export function resolveServerConfig(config: Config): ResolvedServerConfig { const server: ResolvedServerConfig = { command: config.command ?? DEFAULT_COMMAND, args: config.args ?? [...DEFAULT_ARGS], extensionToLanguage: { ...DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, ...(config.extensionToLanguage ?? {}) }, } if (config.env !== undefined) server.env = config.env if (config.initializationOptions !== undefined) server.initializationOptions = config.initializationOptions if (config.configuration !== undefined) server.configuration = config.configuration if (config.maxMessageBytes !== undefined) server.maxMessageBytes = config.maxMessageBytes if (config.maxStderrBytes !== undefined) server.maxStderrBytes = config.maxStderrBytes if (config.maxDocumentBytes !== undefined) server.maxDocumentBytes = config.maxDocumentBytes if (config.shutdownTimeoutMs !== undefined) server.shutdownTimeoutMs = config.shutdownTimeoutMs if (config.killGraceMs !== undefined) server.killGraceMs = config.killGraceMs return server } ```
**依据 2 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts:120-169](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/src/index.ts#L120-L169) 宽 catch 和默认扩展 fallback。
查看原文（50行） ```text /** A provider that keeps extension routing alive while the server is missing. */ class UnavailableProvider implements LspProvider { readonly id = LspProviderId(PROVIDER_ID) readonly extensionToLanguage: Readonly> constructor(extensions: Readonly>, private readonly reason: string) { this.extensionToLanguage = { ...extensions } } query(_request: LspProviderQuery): Promise { const message = 'language server for ' + PROVIDER_ID + ' is unavailable: ' + this.reason + '. ' + 'Install the language server (see the pack README) and reload the profile or session.' return Promise.reject(new LspError(message, 'LSP_UNAVAILABLE')) } } /** Extract a stable message from an unknown load-time failure. */ function failureMessage(error: unknown): string { if (error instanceof Error) return error.message return String(error) } /** * Register the configured stdio provider for the language, or a structured * no-server fallback when the executable cannot be resolved at load. * * The pack never crashes the session: an unresolvable server only disables * this language routing and surfaces `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` on queries. * @param ctx - the plugin context (must inject `fs`, `lsp`, `subprocess`). * @param config - the resolved pack configuration. */ export async function apply(ctx: Context, config: Config): Promise { const server = resolveServerConfig(config) try { // Resolve through lsp-stdio’s own Config schema so every documented default // (timer budgets, byte caps, env, ...) is filled before apply() — calling the // stdio apply directly bypasses the Cordis loader’s schema pass. const stdioConfig = LspStdio.Config({ servers: { [PROVIDER_ID]: server } }) await LspStdio.apply(ctx, stdioConfig) return } catch (error) { const reason = failureMessage(error) console.warn('[' + name + '] ' + DEFAULT_COMMAND + ' unavailable at load: ' + reason) ctx.effect(() => { const dispose = ctx.lsp.registerProvider( new UnavailableProvider(DEFAULT_EXTENSION_TO_LANGUAGE, reason), ) return () => dispose() }, name + '.unavailableFallback') ```
**依据 3 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-lua/README.md:33-57](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/README.md#L33-L57) 作者声明 lazy start/缺服降级/覆盖。
查看原文（25行） ````text ## How the pack works - **Lazy start**: the server process is **not** started at load. `lsp-stdio` launches it lazily on the first matching query and keeps one process per workspace. - **No-server fallback**: if the executable cannot be resolved, the pack still loads; every `lsp` query for these extensions fails with a structured `LSP_UNAVAILABLE` error naming the command — the rest of the session is unaffected. - **Config overrides**: every default below can be overridden from the composition row, e.g. a server installed at a non-standard path: ```yaml - id: lsp-lua name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-lua' config: command: /absolute/path/to/lua-language-server args: - --stdio extensionToLanguage: '.xyz': custom-language-id maxDocumentBytes: 8000000 ``` All fields of the `servers` table documented in the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-lsp-stdio` README are accepted (`command`, `args`, `env`, `extensionToLanguage`, `initializationOptions`, `configuration`, byte/time bounds). ````
#### 缺口 - 未构造配置错误或额外扩展故障 **影响：**用户可见错误类型待验证 **进一步探讨：**隔离测试命令缺失、非法配置、.xyz 路由 ### Q03 · 在 Lua 工程采用的条件和证据范围是什么？ **研究主题：**依赖、兼容与流程、采用判断 #### 完整回答 需已有共享 LSP service/tool 和 fs/subprocess，且 lua-language-server 在 DSH PATH。测试源码有默认值、缺服两条离线 lane；真实 LuaLS lane 在 binary 缺失时 skip，以单文件 sample.lua 测四项工具，未要求项目 manifest。由于 goToImplementation 对简单函数的结果取决于 LuaLS 语义，测试存在不等于已通过。实际工作区索引/诊断和 --stdio 支持需宿主验证。 #### 证据与依据 **依据 1 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-lua/README.md:13-27](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/README.md#L13-L27) lua-language-server 安装路径与外部依赖。
查看原文（15行） ````text ## Installing the language server ```bash # Homebrew: brew install lua-language-server # scoop: scoop install lua-language-server # or download a release binary from github.com/LuaLS/lua-language-server ``` `lua-language-server` must be on `PATH`; stdio mode is requested with `--stdio`, which this pack passes by default. > ⚠️ The plugin itself **never downloads or installs the server binary** — matching the > upstream anthropics LSP plugins, the server is an external prerequisite. The plugin only > resolves and launches it. ````
**依据 2 · 作者声明**：[dsh-lsp-lua/README.md:59-95](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/README.md#L59-L95) 挂载/测试/许可声明。
查看原文（37行） ````text ## Mounting 1. Mount the shared base **once** (the `lsp` service, the `lsp` tool, and a filesystem/subprocess pair for the same execution world) — ready-made snippet in `examples/base-composition.cordis.yml` of the dsh-lsp-packs repo. 2. Install the pack (its `cordis.yml` is the `dsh.bundle.patch`, so the row inserts itself): ```bash dsh plugin add @dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-lua # published name dsh plugin add /path/to/dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-lua # or a local checkout ``` or compose the row directly (name resolved from the installed package): ```yaml - insert: - id: lsp-lua name: '@dsh-lsp-packs/dsh-lsp-lua' ``` ## Smoke test ```bash pnpm vitest run --dir dsh-lsp-lua # or from the repo root: pnpm test ``` - Lane 1 (offline): asserts the defaults (command / args / extension table / provider id). - Lane 2 (offline): asserts the missing-server fallback returns `LSP_UNAVAILABLE`. - Lane 3 (needs the server): runs the four `lsp` operations against `sample.lua`; it **auto-skips** when `lua-language-server` is not on PATH. LuaLS indexes single files without a project manifest. ## License MIT — see `LICENSE`. The server binary is a third-party component with its own license. ````
**依据 3 · 源码核查**：[dsh-lsp-lua/tests/smoke.e2e.ts:24-41](https://github.com/988hj7tczd-oss/dsh-lsp-packs/blob/258bb6409c504fa1eed20b6f70d13009522ca0ce/dsh-lsp-lua/tests/smoke.e2e.ts#L24-L41) 实际服务器探测与 skip 前提。
查看原文（18行） ```text /** Probe whether the language server binary truly runs. */ function probeServer(command: string): boolean { const probe = spawnSync(command, ['--version'], { encoding: 'utf8', timeout: 10_000, shell: process.platform === 'win32', }) // Spawn failure or timeout (ENOENT / killed) never counts as installed. if (probe.error !== undefined || probe.status === null) return false if (probe.status === 0) return true // Some servers (e.g. sourcekit-lsp) reject `--version` with a usage error while // running fine; only output saying the binary itself is missing skips the lane // (this also skips a rustup shim whose component is not installed). const output = String(probe.stdout ??
